claim: Euro Space Center in Transinne (~30 min from Paliseul) is open 9:00 to 16:00 (last entry) with visits lasting about 6 hours, and booking online saves €2 per ticket.
quote: Open from 9:00am to 4:00pm (last entry) ... Book in advance and save €2 per ticket!

claim: Euro Space Center reviews are mixed: families with kids 8-11 enjoy gravity simulators, moonwalk and virtual missions, but some say ages 6-12 found it boring and prices excessive for the quality.
quote: Activities are engaging and interactive, designed for adults and children, from gravity simulators to training tests to virtual space missions

claim: Grottes de Han 2026 prices: Cave only adult €29 / child 4-11 €22; PassHan (cave + wildlife park) adult €41.50 / child €31.50; under-4s free.
quote: GROTTE : adulte 29€ - enfant (4-11 ans) 22€ ... PASSHAN : adulte 41,50€ - enfant (4-11 ans) 31,50€

claim: Grottes de Han is open daily in late May 2026 except 11, 12 and 18 May, with the Cave Discovery tour lasting 1h15 and the longer Cave Journey 2 hours over 510 steps.
quote: Mai : ouvert tous les jours (sauf les 11, 12 et 18 Mai = fermé) ... 'Cave Discovery' dure 1h15 ... 'Cave Journey' dure 2 heures avec 510 marches

claim: Bouillon Castle entry is €7 adult / €5 child 4-12, and the Bouillon City Pass+ (April-November 2026) combining castle, Musée Ducal, Medieval Experience and the Odyssée de Lumière light show is €16 adult / €12 child.
quote: Individual castle admission: Adults €7, 65+ €6, Students €5.50, Children (4-12 years) €5 ... Bouillon City Pass+ ... Adults and 65+ €16

claim: Bouillon Medieval Experience is a fully indoor immersive show in a former Sepulcrines convent, lasting 30-45 minutes with audio guides in FR/NL/DE/EN, praised for scenography but criticised for limited seating.
quote: immersive attraction that takes you back to the 11th century through the latest audiovisual technologies

claim: The Archéoscope Godefroid de Bouillon, housed in a 17th-century convent next to the castle, runs a multilingual film every 35 minutes followed by a walk-through dark room with a replica of Godefroid's Jerusalem tomb.
quote: Visits start every 35 minutes with a multilingual film, after which you walk through the screen into a darkened space

claim: The Musée du Tabac de la Semois in Corbion (Vresse-sur-Semois) operates by appointment only via +32 61 46 81 29 and documents the local Semois tobacco heritage that made the region famous.
quote: Le Musée du Tabac de la Semois ... +32 61 46 81 29

claim: Orval Abbey (~1h drive) is open June-September 9:30-18:30, with a 2-hour visit covering the Cistercian ruins, the Caves Dewez museum, the brewery exhibition in the 17th-century Communs Abraham, and a medicinal-plant pharmacy garden; the working brewery itself opens only on special Open Door days.
quote: In June, July, August and September, Orval is open from 9:30 to 18:30 ... the brewery is only open to visitors on special Open Door days

claim: Basilique Saint-Hubert (~35 min from Paliseul) is open daily 10:00-18:00 from Easter to All Saints with free entry, €2 guided tours, and a €3 reservable attic tour.
quote: open daily from Easter to All Saints' Day (10:00–18:00) ... guided tours available for €2 per person and access to the attic areas available after reservation for €3

claim: Brasserie Lupulus in Bovigny/Courtil (Gouvy) runs guided tours including a tasting and souvenir glass, daily during Belgian school holidays, restricted to visitors over 16 unless arranged in advance.
quote: Only individuals over 16 years old can be registered for tours ... Tours are open every day during Belgian school holidays

claim: Brasserie de Bertinchamps near Gembloux offers small-group 1-hour brewery tours at 10:30 on Saturdays and Sundays for €6 including a gallopin tasting, with an attached restaurant La Table de Bertinchamps.
quote: The brewery tour lasts 1 hour and takes place in small groups on Saturdays and Sundays at 10:30 am, booking required, with a price of €6 including a gallopin at the end

claim: Brasserie de la Lesse near Rochefort offers 40-minute brewery tours ending with a tasting on the café terrace, at €12/adult with tasting or €7 without, bookable online.
quote: 12€ par adulte avec dégustation, et 7€ par enfant (à partir de 12 ans) sans dégustation ... visites durent environ 40 minutes

claim: Brasserie Sainte-Hélène in Florenville (relocated from Ethe in 2016) only accepts brewery visits by appointment for groups of 5 to 50 people with 15 days' notice.
quote: Visits are by appointment for groups of 5 to 50 people, with reservations required 15 days in advance

claim: Brasserie de Bouillon opens to groups of 8+ by booking; solo visitors can otherwise stop at Le Marché de Nathalie in Bouillon town centre which stocks over 300 Belgian beer labels.
quote: open year-round for group visits of a minimum of 8 people ... Le Marché de Nathalie shop in the city centre ... over 300 labels for sale

claim: La Ferme des Fées at Les Hayons near Bouillon is a free-admission indoor attraction showcasing handmade 1/4-scale figurines of fairies, witches and 19th-century Ardennes life, open Thursday-Saturday 10:00-12:30 and 13:30-18:00.
quote: handcrafted and hand-painted figurines at 1/4 scale ... Thursday-Saturday from 10:00 AM - 12:30 PM and 1:30 PM - 6:00 PM

claim: Ardois'Alle in Alle-sur-Semois (≈20 min from Paliseul) is a former slate mine converted into a museum showcasing the region's slate-quarrying history, listed on the Réseau Ardoise d'Ardenne trail.
quote: An old slate mine in Alle-sur-Semois was also turned into a museum to showcase the region's history
